figures.caption: Table 3: Main results on SWE-Gym Holdout and SWE-Bench Verified. The upper block compares post-training methods under matched student initialization and training scaffold. The lower block reports published SWE-Bench Verified results from representative SWE-agent systems. We report task-resolution rate; higher is better. The best and second-best scores within each backbone block are emphasized in bold and underlined, respectively.

Table 4: Qualitative failure analysis on SWE-bench Verified. We use an LLM-as-a-judge protocol to assign one primary failure mode to each unresolved trajectory.
